title: Humidifiers: Simpler is better?
summary: Technology Connections explains why humidity matters and compares the main types of humidifiers, including evaporative and ultrasonic designs. It covers how and why you would add moisture to indoor air.
why: HN links it whenever humidifiers come up as the go-to explainer favoring simple evaporative designs over ultrasonic ones.

quote.text: Technology connections covers quite a bit of ground on various types of humidifiers and their up/downsides
